The '''Slithering Scar''' is a [[subzone]] in the southern part of [[Un'goro Crater]] and is home to one of the minor [[silithid]] [[hives]] named '''Gorishi'''. It may be significant that there are no silithid hives near the Un'Goro [[Power crystals|pylons]] except in the south, where a southern pylon is mysteriously absent. The [[Gorishi Silithid Crystal]] can be found inside the hive.
